admission.justification: The public writer regression rejects five kinds of object that could otherwise make a recorded closure point at something other than a real code commit, without partial writes.

applicability: An explicit commit supplied in a closed weakness block through the task-bound knowledge writer.
conditions: The typed closure field is a Git object ID; the code repository resolver must return the identical full commit ID.
The code object must be available in the admitted code repository.
exclusions: An absent commit follows the current-task closure and required-reason rules instead.
A stored explicit commit is displayed unchanged by the reader; this is not a promise that every read revalidates that stored attribution.

evidence: 261112-BUG-L3-W9-worker.md, item17 acceptance block, checks and Closure census; W9-evidence.tar.gz contains the exact red/green test results and executable commands.

statement: An explicitly supplied closure commit must be the full identity of a real commit in the code repository.
